details:
You could add more quick actions into the Radial Menu such as quickly rejoining a world instance or respawning your character. There was a game modification that allowed the quick-use of these actions. Other than accessibility actions that could be implemented into VRChat in the future, it would be nice to have an button for Respawning, Rejoin Instance, and a Go Home. These may not be used much, I find myself often utilizing these tools in cases where they're needed.
'Go Home' would be a neat, quick option to leave an instance when it gets overwhelming or an increase of toxic or bad-behaving players. I had a case where I would join some older worlds that would have their lobby far from 0, 0 causing the int overflow visual effect and my Quick Menu being nearly ineffective. I can hardly click on any buttons in the QM, resorting to restarting my game to leave the broken world/instance.
'Rejoin Instance' would be used for fixing any syncing problems, audio bugs, or other world issues!
'Respawn' would be nice to have added as a quick action but not entirely needed. I didn't find myself using this too much but could be good for others.
title: More Radial Menu Actions
